user.title: Select BK215 batteries
user.description: Select the **BK215 systems** this EMS should control. One entry represents one BK215 (including any attached B215 expansion batteries). SoC, charging/discharging limits and PV input sensors are detected from the existing SunEnergyXT integration. Use **Correct detected entities** only if a suggestion is wrong. No output command is sent until setup is completed.

battery_manual.title: Battery sensors
battery_manual.description: No matching BK215 device was found. Choose a **SoC sensor in %**, a **minimum discharge limit**, and optionally an upper SoC limit. Do not select an unrelated sensor. At least one individually writable inverter is required on the next page.

inverters.title: Assign inverters
inverters.description: Assign **one or two independently controllable inverters to each BK215**. Select the device physically connected to that battery; a single inverter cannot be assigned twice. The EMS writes only to that inverter's Home Assistant **power-limit entity**, not its raw communications protocol. Choose manual selection if the device is not offered. Check the physical wiring before continuing.

grid.title: Select the grid meter
grid.description: Select a **current signed grid power sensor**, not a cumulative energy (kWh) or individual phase sensor. **Positive = buying from the grid; negative = exporting**. Verify this sign with the live value; reverse it only if the sensor reports the opposite. The EMS uses a single meter for all batteries. **Before completing this page, disable every other automation that writes the same inverter power limits. Finishing setup enables the new live controller automatically** when valid measurements are available.

confirm.title: Start energy management
confirm.description: **Live control starts after you finish setup** and current readings are valid. Do not leave another writer controlling any selected inverter limit. To review assignments later, use **Reconfigure**; to stop or change the operating mode, use **Configure**.

correct.title: Review battery mapping
correct.description: Review the detected sensor mapping for each BK215. **State of charge** is in %, **discharge limit** is the minimum battery SoC allowed by SunEnergyXT, and **charge limit** is the upper SoC target. Leave valid existing entities selected: the EMS reads their current values and follows future changes. An upper limit is optional for normal household-load control.

ratings.title: Inverter rated power
ratings.description: Your inverter's Home Assistant power limit is given in **%**, so the EMS needs the **inverter's rated AC output in watts** to convert requested watts into percentages. Example: a 2,000 W inverter at 10% is limited to about 200 W. Enter the manufacturer's actual AC rating, **not** the PV panel watt-peak rating or BK215 battery capacity. This is not a target to export.

reconfigure.title: Change EMS devices
reconfigure.description: Select the BK215 systems to keep or add. Review inverter assignments and the shared meter on the next pages. Operating settings are preserved. Reconfiguration safely stops previous inverter control before switching.

inverters_manual.title: Select inverter power limits manually
inverters_manual.description: Choose one or two Home Assistant **number** entities per BK215 that represent an **inverter AC active-power limit** in W or %. Do not select voltage, frequency, power-factor or battery charging controls. Verify which physical inverter belongs to each battery.

error.invalid_setup: Check the selected sensors and power limits.
error.duplicate_inverter: Each inverter can only be assigned once.
error.invalid_inverter: Choose one or two inverter limits per battery.
error.inverter_stop_failed: Could not safely lower a previous inverter. Check the device and try again.

init.description: The EMS uses one shared grid meter. **Household demand** follows the house load regardless of upper SoC and avoids intentional export. **PV generation** releases the inverter's configured output limit only after the battery reaches the configured upper SoC threshold and may export stored energy. Keep feed-in off until hardware-tested.
